prompts.jump_charge:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make ONE production game animation sprite, a new pose of exactly the blue Pheeeew character 'defeated' shown in the input references. References in order: front identity and exact texture; left-facing side anatomy; three-quarter identity. This is not a redesign. Match the original broad dome/slime body, icy light blue watercolor crystalline mottling, thick almost black rounded contour, white upper-left shine strokes, pale blue mitten hands and flat oval feet. Preserve worried raised inner eyebrows, drooping CLOSED crescent eyes, small downturned arc mouth, blue oval cheeks and the single existing WHITE TEAR on cheek (identity feature, not an extra sweat drop). No head symbol. Never smile, open eyes wide, or add facial details.
Output: square 1024x1024 RGBA PNG with ACTUAL transparent background, no white or black background, no baked checkerboard, no shadows, floor, text, props, particles, motion lines, extra sweat or drops. Exactly one complete character. Thick contour weight must match reference at same scale (about 14-18 pixels), not a thin-line sketch. Keep reference watercolor texture and pale icy blue color; no dark blue new palette. Keep all anatomy in frame. Nominal body width EXCLUDING hands/feet is 780 pixels; allow only 741-819 pixels. Center body horizontally on x=512 and put the lowest visible extremity at y=900. Leave empty transparent margin. Pose deformation must be drawn naturally with adjusted limbs, not simply scale the entire source. Facing left means eyes/mouth on the left edge like side.png, not face toward camera.
POSE: jump_charge: FRONT VIEW. Deep pre-jump crouch, body squashed low and spreading sideways, distinctly flatter than neutral, body approx 810 wide and 460 high. Both mitten hands lowered and planted near the lower left and lower right of body, both oval feet firmly at the lowest baseline. Face still visible, SAME dejected expression with tear. Compress body, preserve same hand/foot size and thick stroke. No ground.

refinements.jump_rise: Change ONLY the orientation of the character in first image: tilt its whole posture 10 degrees COUNTERCLOCKWISE so the TOP of the head leans toward the LEFT, clearly toward upper-left ascent. Hands still behind toward lower-right, feet dangling down. Maintain exact character, expression, watercolor colors, stroke and all proportions. Not tilted to right. Do not add anything.
refinements.jump_fall: Change ONLY body proportions of first image: reduce its BODY HEIGHT by about 18 percent while keeping BODY WIDTH the same. This should be a ROUND plump dome just SLIGHTLY vertically stretched, not a very tall egg. Arms still raised high, feet tucked. Keep pose and original face exactly. Reference 2 is neutral body thickness. Complete sprite extent must fit comfortably within square. Body width780 height700; total character height at most800. Shorten the body WITHOUT making hands or face taller/smaller.
refinements.jump_wall: Change ONLY body proportions of first image: reduce BODY HEIGHT by 23 percent, keep BODY WIDTH. The body should be broad and plump, about 780 wide and 700 tall, not a narrow tall pillar. Maintain long flattened vertical LEFT edge from invisible wall collision, same left-facing closed sad eye, brow, white cheek tear and frown. Hands and feet thrown behind toward RIGHT. Keep all appendages compact close to body so total silhouette width stays below980 at bodywidth780. No wall. No nose.
refinements.jump_splat: Change ONLY the limbs and canvas composition of first image: keep very flattened broad body, SAME sad face and pale blue watercolor thick stroke. Make the four appendages SMALLER and closer to sides so they project at most75 pixels outside body on EACH side. Small original mitten hands and small oval feet, two distinct appendages each side. Body width810px, bodyheight300px, TOTAL silhouette width including limbs at most970px. Output SQUARE1024x1024 not panorama. Bottom baseline900, center512. Do not change expression or add anything.
